Model: RSPG512HEXA

Hitachi 1.0 Ton Wall Mounted DC Inverter Air Conditioner

The Hitachi RSPG512HEXA is a 1.0 Ton wall-mounted DC Inverter split AC built for reliable, energy-efficient cooling in small to mid-sized rooms. With Hitachi's signature inverter technology, it adjusts compressor speed to match room load, delivering quiet operation, faster cooling, and lower power consumption compared to fixed-speed units.

Features that make your decision a smart choice

1

Silent air

Ensure air-cutting noise reduction with Wave Blade Design Technology.

2

Big Flow Deflector

Uniform cooling and heating in every corner of the room.

3

Odour-free air

STOPS
ODOUR

Have uninterrupted airflow with the Auto Coil Dry Technology that prevents odour and mold growth inside the AC.

4

Penta Sensor

Indoor unit Microcontroller Outdoor unit

Hitachi's intelligent Penta sensor technology with its advanced microcontroller offers perfect cooling even in extreme summer conditions, optimises cooling in load variation and protects critical components of the ACs.

5

Xpandable

Hitachi's Xpandable AC expands its capacity in adverse temperature conditions. It cuts down humidity level inside the room and achieves the set temperature faster.

6

Stabilizer-Free Operation

Have complete protection from power fluctuation that ranges from 160V to 255V with more savings.

7

Tropical design works from -15°C to 52°C

Now, have comfort all around the year with hot & cold AC. Hitachi ACs work efficiently in extreme weather conditions ranging from -15°C to 52°C.

8

100% Inner Grooved Copper Tube

Hitachi's 100% inner grooved copper ensures faster cooling with its turbulent refrigerant flow that enhances heat transfer rate.

9

SuperSlit Fins

SuperSlit fins of Hitachi AC have multiple slits that provide more heat exchange area and cools the room faster.

10

Filter Clean Indicator

A unique alert reminds you to clean the filter at regular intervals, ensuring powerful cooling all the time.

11

SuperFine Mesh Filter

Hitachi's unique SuperFine mesh filter captures microdust particle and also offers hassle-free cleaning.

12

100% Cooling Capacity @ 43°C
